newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 1.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 1.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Winds from the northwest from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high.

Weak cold front headed slowly southeast bringing lower temperatures, clouds and rains to the northwest gulf and expected to affect Tamaulipas coast tonight. Generally clear skies along coast and winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high.
Hot and clear to partly cloudy with winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
